services.desc: Beautiful, clean, late-model pontoon boats. No hidden booking fees. Available for 4, 6, or 8-hour rentals. This beautiful 2021 Sport pontoon boat comes complete with a second-story and a water-fed slide! Features a cooler, GPS, Bluetooth stereo, and all required safety equipment. Currently only available for rental with a licensed captain. We don't supply captains, but if you need one, we know plenty, and will be happy to hook you up! A spacious and reliable pontoon boat perfect for families and groups. Enjoy a day on the water exploring the beautiful Pinellas County Gulf Coast from our Madeira Beach marina.
